mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,caller_task_id FROM ((SELECT tenant_id,caller_task_id,next_validation_at FROM task_session_scope FORCE INDEX(scope_validation) WHERE content_state='PRESENT' AND grant_state='ACTIVE' AND next_validation_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY next_validation_at,tenant_id,caller_task_id LIMIT 8) UNION ALL (SELECT tenant_id,caller_task_id,next_validation_at FROM task_session_scope FORCE INDEX(scope_validation) WHERE content_state='PRESENT' AND grant_state='REVOKED' AND next_validation_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY next_validation_at,tenant_id,caller_task_id LIMIT 8)) bounded ORDER BY next_validation_at,tenant_id,caller_task_id LIMIT 8
SELECT capabilities FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{caller}
SELECT source_task_id FROM task_session_scope_target FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 9
SELECT id FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{caller} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,caller_task_id,record_version,authority_version,owner_actor_id,caller_binding_digest,caller_tools_digest,authority_snapshot,authority_digest,authority_bytes,candidate_count,grant_state,created_at,retain_until,revoked_at,invalidated_at,next_validation_at,content_state,retain_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AS retained FROM task_session_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,caller_task_id,ordinal,record_version,source_task_id,target_snapshot,target_digest,target_bytes,content_state FROM task_session_scope_target FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 9
SELECT ordinal FROM task_session_scope_target FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller} LIMIT 1
SELECT retain_until>=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,180,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS retained FROM task_session_history WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{caller}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_session_scope SET next_validation_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller}
UPDATE task_session_scope SET invalidated_at=COALESCE(invalidated_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller}

UPDATE task_session_scope SET invalidated_at=COALESCE(invalidated_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),next_validation_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{caller} AND content_state='PRESENT'
